definition.logits_from: position t* - 1 of a single forward pass over prompt + common prefix
definition.t_star: prompt_len + length of the longest token prefix shared by the correct answer and every matched distractor
definition.why_not_full_sequence: The full-sequence margin teacher-forces every answer token, so later tokens are conditioned on earlier correct answer tokens. Attribution against it would credit components that continue a partially written answer alongside components that retrieve the fact. 81% of SUITE answers are multi-token.
definition.conditioning: Only the prompt plus the token prefix shared by all candidates. No correct-answer-specific prefix is conditioned on.

rejection_reasons.candidate_is_prefix_of_another: A candidate answer ends at or before t*, so it has no token to compare.
rejection_reasons.distractor_shares_correct_token_at_t_sta: A distractor has the same token as the correct answer at t*, so the margin would compare the correct token against itself.
rejection_reasons.empty_answer_tokens: A candidate contributed no answer tokens.

companion_metric.name: factual_margin_v1
companion_metric.role: behavioral evaluation and exact causal validation
companion_metric.note: Retained unchanged. J_f never replaces it for causal claims.

definition.consistency_check: Spearman correlation between J_f and M_f across all pilot surfaces is reported in discovery_objective.json. They measure related but distinct quantities, so the check is for sane agreement, not equality.

surface_consistency.scope: all scored surfaces, correct and incorrect, so the range is not restricted

common_prefix_tokens.note: Zero means J_f conditions on the prompt alone, with no answer token conditioned on at all.

pair_direction_consistency.criterion: Attribution is computed against the clean-corrupt difference, so agreement on its sign is what the objective must satisfy.

interpretation: J_f and M_f agree in sign on 74.3% of individual surfaces (83.5% of surfaces have J_f>0 versus 66.3% for M_f). J_f is the more permissive of the two because it only requires the discriminative token to be right, whereas M_f requires the whole answer sequence to beat the distractors on average. That gap is the answer-prefix effect J_f exists to avoid, seen from the other side.
On clean/corrupt pairs the two agree in sign 100.0% of the time (0 disagreements of 60). That is the property attribution depends on.
verdict_note: J_f is registered for A1 discovery only. Every causal claim in A1 is validated with the full-sequence factual margin M_f, which is unchanged from P0-P5.
